SRE-Bot: [ALERT] High cross-region health-check churn detected for deployment: recommendation-service (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu). 3xx/5xx spike + repeated region failover within last 3m :rotating_light:
Alice M: seeing it too. traffic oscillating between us-east and us-west every ~20s, then spill to eu. customers hitting increased latency/errors. paging oncall-ml now.
Ben K: logs from the routing proxy show health probe flapping: consecutive healthcheck failures then recoveries from the same targets. suspecting probe timeout sensitivity after the kernel update on our edge nodes. grabbing probe logs.
Charlie: @Ben K paste from proxy (truncated):
```
[2026-03-15T12:05:22Z] upstream us-east-1a: OK
[2026-03-15T12:05:42Z] upstream us-east-1a: FAIL (503)
[2026-03-15T12:06:01Z] upstream us-east-1a: OK
[2026-03-15T12:06:22Z] upstream us-west-2b: OK
[2026-03-15T12:06:42Z] upstream us-west-2b: FAIL (timeout)
```
Charlie: note the timestamps — near synchronous oscillation.
Oncall-ML: I'm live. Already seeing model variant mismatch errors in logs when the router flips — some requests get sent to a quantized variant that isn't pinned in the new region and returns malformed responses (json parse errors). This explains customer 500s.
Dana (CS): Customer reports: "sudden spike in failed completions, some returned gibberish" for several enterprise tenants. Prioritized customers affected: @AcmeCorp, @NimbusAI.
Alice M: mitigation plan attempt 1: temporarily disable cross-region automatic failover for the route "recommendation-service" so only intra-region fallback allowed. Doing this to stop the loop while we investigate. Will annotate in console.
Ben K: +1. Also increasing probe interval to 30s and raising healthy threshold from 2->3 to avoid flapping during transient blips. Pushing config to routing tier now: ``curl -XPOST https://console.redwood/route-config -d '{"route":"recommendation-service","cross_region_failover":false}'``
Ops-Bot: deploy started by Ben K: config-routing/2026-03-15-1208 (rollout id r-4f2d).
SRE-Bot: Incident severity: P2 due to multi-tenant customer impact and automated paging. Page: #oncall-ml.
Oncall-ML: I'm pausing the smart-routing policy for this route and pinning model variant to "rec-v1.2-quant" in us-east and us-west (pre-rolled). Command: ``redwoodctl rollout set --route recommendation-service --variant rec-v1.2-quant --scope {us-east,us-west}``
Charlie: After pinning, we're still seeing a few lingering 502s from eu because the eu pool had in-flight requests routed incorrectly. I'll clear eu routing cache and restart the regional proxy: ``sudo systemctl restart rproxy-eu``
Ben K: Config rollout complete, probe interval updated. Early metrics: error-rate decreased from 11.8% -> 3.2% in 3m, p95 latency improved ~200ms.
Dana (CS): Notifying affected customers: I sent an ETA update to AcmeCorp and NimbusAI with our mitigation steps. They asked for root cause once stabilized.
Alice M: Root-cause hypothesis: an aggressive kernel/network update on a subset of edge nodes increased tail probe latency; combined with low health thresholds and cross-region failover created a positive feedback loop where failovers induced extra load, causing more probe failures elsewhere. Also observed model variant sync lag between regions causing malformed responses during rapid failovers.
Oncall-ML: Next actions: 1) Re-enable cross-region failover only after we validate probe stability for 30m. 2) Push a fix to health-check agent to add jitter and extend TCP timeout for probes. 3) Add a pre-check to routing logic to verify variant availability in target region before failover.
Charlie: I'll create a short-runbook snippet for oncall: ``If cross-region oscillation detected -> disable cross-region failover -> pin variants -> increase probe thresholds -> restart proxies -> monitor 30m`` and put it in /runbooks/incidents/oscillating-probes.md (for now).
SRE-Bot: Recorder: timeline & actions logged under incident-2109876543. Please mark with :white_check_mark: when you've completed follow-ups.
Ben K: Follow-up completed: probe client change PR opened (PR #4567) with increased timeout and probe jitter. Will request expedited review.
Oncall-ML: Handing off to SRE rotation at 13:00Z for long-tail monitoring. Leaving notes in incident doc.
Dana (CS): Customers acknowledged the update and will watch for anomalies. No escalations at this time.
Alice M: Status: mitigated. Keeping incident open for RCA and postmortem. Will assign postmortem owners and target a write-up within 48h. Thanks all. :bow:
